avis.titre: Good for a skin care routine

After use, the skin feels extremely clean — almost “squeaky clean,” although I know some people believe this is not ideal for the skin. I use it occasionally, and I can’t say that my skin has changed significantly for the better. For me, it feels more like a skincare ritual than a product with a noticeable long-term effect. The scent is pleasant and the texture is nice to use.

avis.titre: 2-in-1 mask and cleanser that really works
avis.texte: This product is such a time-saver! I love that it works both as a mask and a cleanser — perfect for busy mornings or evenings when I don’t have time for a long routine. The texture feels gentle, doesn’t strip my skin, and leaves it soft and calm. After using it, my face looks clean, fresh, and less irritated. A great product for sensitive skin and everyday use

avis.titre: Leaves skin very soft and squeaky clean; not as drying as traditional clay mask; contains fragrance
avis.texte: I like this combination of clay mask and cleanser because it's less drying than standard clay masks (which my dry, sensitive skin can't tolerate). I left it on my face for 5 minutes while massaging it into my skin, and it never dried out. There are specks of something in the cleanser but they didn't feel abrasive, and silica is the 7th ingredient so there was likely some gentle physical exfoliation. When I added water, it created the silkiest foam I've ever felt, and when I rinsed it off my skin felt squeaky clean. I mean this literally because my skin made a slight sound and felt similar to the way it does with bar soaps, such as Irish Spring. I usually don't like that feeling, but when my skin dried it felt a bit tight (similar to after a gel cleanser) but also incredibly soft, almost powdery soft. I then put on a serum and a moisturizer and my skin felt well hydrated and moisturized as well as soft. I posted a photo with the ingredient list to help potential buyers evaluate the product. This cleanser contains added fragrance (as the 20th ingredient).

avis.titre: Nice herb based 2 in one mask cleanser
avis.texte: **Background:** I'm an older adult who's relatively new to taking care of of my skin. I've never used a combination mask/cleanser. The idea of being able to get the benefits of a clay and then just rinse it off and it works as a cleanser is really appealing. Both saving time and not having to have two separate products. **First impression:** This is a really thick sticky paste. It has pleasant plant smell to it. **application:** You can use this several different ways. You can apply it really thick and leave it on like a mask. It will not dry but then you rinse it several minutes later. When you apply it as a mask, it's first this really thick sticky paste, after letting it sit when you first start applying water, it turns into a thick creamy paste almost doubling in volume. Then, as you continued to wet your face, it turns into a sudsy cleanser. If you apply thick as a mask it definitely takes longer to rinse your face off then a typical cleanser. Or you can use much less and just use it more like a facial wash. Within the green paste is this slightly gritty material that helps exfoliate your skin. **Conclusions:** I definitely felt like the mask absorbed a lot of the excess oil on my skin without being harsh. It's definitely more concentrated than it appears and so apply less than you think you need as I will thicken up as you add the water while rinsing. I think this is an interesting two in one product. It's perfect for oily skin.
